description: Asks, on a writable copy, what limits and spellings CREATE and ALTER accept through Database.Execute (dbFailOnError), each followed by DBEngine.Errors where it may fail: table, column, index and constraint names of 64 and 65 characters; tables of 255, 256 and 300 Long columns; tables of 8, 16 and 17 Text(255) columns with a row inserted whose every column holds 255 characters (and 255 euro-sign characters for 8); an index over 10 and over 11 columns; 32 and then 33 single-column indexes on one table; bracketed names with a space, dot, bang, escaped bracket, edge spaces, empty and blank text, U+0000, tab, CR/LF, accents, an astral pair, a lone surrogate, a tilde, an MSys and a USys prefix and punctuation; and a table created twice, in another case and over an existing table. The TableDefs names are listed at the end. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
